limits: Locus crosswalks explicitly normalize one EF namespace separator, not arbitrary punctuation or gene symbols.
The V583 proteins are reference context, not experimental derivatives or exact resistance alleles.
Native LiaX naming is retained; the newer nomenclature paper and earlier linked study remain unreviewed.
Selected HTML results are reviewed; original figures, the replacement figure and supplements are not.
Homologue function, same-background association and a reference locus are not independent causal proof.
The old pooled gene query has one result but no exact match for these four source genes; this is not biological absence.
Claim reference_status fields retain the input-index checkpoint; term_pointer resolves the new assessment.
No sequences, variant specifications, protocols, numeric AST or experimental genome assignments are exported.
No biological records or source inputs changed; the full-corpus investigation remains OPEN and #1040 deferred.
